name: Itim Group Plc
summary: Itim Group Plc, including its affiliated companies, furnishes software alongside associated implementation and expert advisory services to customers throughout the United Kingdom, Europe, and other international markets. The firm's primary focus is on retail-specific software, providing systems for omnichannel sales and customer engagement, comprehensive enterprise order management, intelligent pricing and stock level optimization, and efficient supplier relationship management. Additionally, Itim Group facilitates data interchange and delivers specialized software consulting and supply. Established in 1993, the company maintains its headquarters in London, UK.
